annotation.bound_parties_text: The working paper binds no one; it describes how existing IHL requirements impose duties on combatants and parties to conflict, but it is a non-binding State submission.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: These requirements impose duties on combatants (and, more broadly, on parties to conflict), and do not impose duties on machines.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: This U.S. working paper addresses the implementation of international humanitarian law (IHL) in the use of autonomy in weapon systems.
